method.metric: sum of per-process RSS from macOS ps, KiB converted to bytes, dedicated Chrome root and current descendants only
limitations: Sampled maximum can miss shorter-lived peaks.
Summed RSS may double-count shared mappings; it is not physical footprint, JS heap or allocated-pixel bytes.
Worker termination and URL release do not guarantee immediate RSS return or prove a memory leak.
Desktop Chrome headless measurements do not establish Safari/iPhone limits.
ZIP verification deliberately decompresses and compares all entries; its memory cost is included separately from ZIP creation timing.

verifiedLibrary.method: replace standalone library module without rebuilding host/worker
